_doc: Positions of the dock board's small parts (KiCad mm, y down, degrees), inside the parts area of dock-pcb/geometry.json (scripts/dock/place.py checks it): on the tab at the back, between the halves, in front of J1 (its pad row at y 33.22, its mouth on the back edge). The contacts and J1 come from geometry.json, not from here. "labels" places the designators that show (the connector and the LED); every other designator is hidden. "trunk_y" is where the 5 V trunk runs across the tab, below the fuse and the TVS, from the fuse out to each arm (scripts/routing/preroutes.py).

R2.why: CC2 pull-down, straight below J1's CC2 pad (B5)

R1.why: CC1 pull-down, straight below J1's CC1 pad (A5)

F1.why: pin 1 (VBUS) up toward J1's VBUS pads, pin 2 (DOCK_5V) down to the 5 V trunk

D1.why: TVS right after the fuse: cathode level with the fuse's pin 2, anode to GND

R3.why: LED resistor, below the 5 V trunk, beside the LED

LED1.why: power LED on the centre line, under the cover's pinhole; anode toward R3
